//: The four shipping projects, named one by one rather than globbed as ../src/**/*.csproj.
A glob would silently pick up a fifth project the day one is added, and whether a new
project belongs in the published reference is a decision somebody should make in a diff.
TargetFramework is pinned because DocFX loads these through MSBuildWorkspace and a
multi-targeted project would otherwise be ambiguous. There is only net10.0 today; the
property is what keeps this file honest if that ever stops being true.
Content is enumerated rather than globbed as **/*.md for one concrete reason: docs/plans/
lives in this directory and is working material, not published documentation. A broad glob
would put an implementation plan on the public site the next time somebody wrote one. That
reason survives #82 unchanged: guides/ is listed explicitly, and plans/ is still not listed.
This site was 'the API reference and nothing else' (#69) until #82, when the wiki's ten guide
pages moved into guides/ and the wiki was retired. The rule behind the old line and the new
one is the same: exactly one canonical copy of each fact. #67 broke it by adding prose while
the wiki stayed canonical, #69 restored it by deleting the prose, and #82 restored it the
other way by deleting the wiki. What has not changed is that repository conventions live in
CLAUDE.md and are not restated here, and that the API reference is generated from the XML
doc comments rather than written twice.
//sitemap: The one place in this repository that spells out the public URL. DocFX emits relative links
everywhere else, which is why the site works unchanged under a /databentodotnet/ path — but a
sitemap has to carry absolute ones, so a wrong value here is the single thing that would point
search engines at a host that does not serve this site.
That is not hypothetical. Until #80 this URL 301'd to herbertsabanal.com and 404'd there,
because the user Pages site carried a custom domain and a custom domain on the user site
rewrites every project page under the account. If this line ever needs to change, the reason
will be a Pages setting outside this repository, not something in docfx.json.
